title: Make claude-apiary fully portable across machines and OSes
problem: Apiary harness has hard-coded absolute paths, hard-coded Python interpreter paths, cwd-derived project keys, and untracked local state. Cloning to a second machine or OS does not produce a working setup without manual edits.
description:
Goal: clone repo + run one bootstrap step = working harness on Windows/macOS/Linux.

Phase 1 - Path & interpreter normalization:
- Audit settings.json + every hook + every skill for absolute paths; replace with $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR or pathlib relative resolution.
- Stop hard-coding /c/Users/.../python.exe; use 'python' on PATH or sys.executable.
- Add requirements.txt (or pyproject.toml) pinning third-party deps to ranges.
- Pick min Python version (likely 3.11); audit for 3.14-only syntax and back-port.

Phase 2 - State portability:
- scripts/bootstrap.py: idempotent, creates ~/.claude/projects/<key>/ with empty notes.jsonl, learnings.jsonl, memory/MEMORY.md; seeds auto-startup-enabled; verifies Python + deps.
- Stable project key: replace cwd-derived key with .claude-project-key file in repo OR hashed git remote URL, so the same repo on different machines shares notes.
- Document optional state-sync recipes (private git repo, rclone) without building sync.

Phase 3 - Cross-platform shell hygiene:
- Audit subprocess calls; replace shell=True + Windows commands with shlex + list-form.
- Replace NUL/nul literals with os.devnull; pathlib everywhere.
- Update CLAUDE.md guidance to be platform-agnostic (current '/dev/null not NUL' line is bash-specific).
- Smoke test matrix: every hook + CLI tool runs --help on Windows-bash and Linux CI.

Phase 4 - Repo-location independence:
- enforce_cli_lookup and friends resolve apiary location via $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, not cwd assumption.
- Skills calling docs/reference/cli_lookup.py are either declared apiary-only or accept a path override.

Phase 5 - Documentation & validation:
- PORTABILITY.md at repo root: prereqs, bootstrap, local-vs-synced state, machine migration.
- Migration guide: export/import for notes, learnings, memory, budgeter logs.
- Acceptance test: clone to fresh VM, bootstrap, run representative session, confirm hooks fire and notes persist.

Open questions to resolve before Phase 1:
- Does Claude Code expand $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR inside settings.json hook commands? If not, every hook needs a wrapper script.
- Project-key change is a breaking migration for the current machine (one-time rename of ~/.claude/projects/<old> to <new>).

Definition of done: clone-to-working-session on a fresh OS in <10 minutes with no manual path edits.
scope: settings.json, all hooks under core/hooks, all skills, scribe project-key derivation, bootstrap script, requirements.txt, PORTABILITY.md
